messages:
sam_infra: Heads-up: over the last 24h we saw a ~3x spike in preemptible evictions in us-central1 which spiked queue latency for the model-serving pool. Looking at market graphs now. Thinking: switch primary to capacity-optimized in us-central, but bias failover to us-east1 and keep a small price-optimized pool for cheap burst. Any obvious gotchas?

leo_sourcing: +1 on capacity-optimized for baseline. Two notes: 1) some GPU families (A100p) have weird capacity availability in us-east1; 2) price-optimized is great for non-SLO traffic but can cause noisy preempts during auctions.

anya_ml: Agree with mixed strategy. Suggest adding a small warm buffer (reserved cheap nodes) so KV cache warmup doesn't blow SLOs on eviction. We saw ~200ms tail increase on last evict wave.

ravi_oncall: Can we add an immediate mitigation that avoids triggering autoscaler thrash? Last time autoscaler scaled down buckets and then had coldstart storm. Maybe increase scale-down-delay to 15m temporarily? @deploy-bot can you run current autoscaler settings?

deploy-bot: autoscaler: model-serving-pool -> scale_down_delay = 600s, min_nodes = 20, max_nodes = 400, current_nodes = 112. (config version 2026-02-18)

mark_prod: Is the plan to change bid strategy globally or per-pool? I'd prefer per-pool so training can remain price-optimized. Also let's not change region weights without a staged rollout.

sam_infra: good call. Plan outline: 1) per-pool policy change -> serving-pool -> capacity-optimized primary, price-fallback pool tagged "burst-cheap" 2) add reserved warm buffer: set min_nodes += 10 (ephemeral reserved) 3) increase scale_down_delay to 900s for 24h 4) telemetry: add eviction-rate alert + per-pool eviction ratio dashboard.

leo_sourcing: For bidding parameters, recommend: 
```
- capacity_strategy: CAPACITY_OPTIMIZED
- max_price_multiplier: 1.0   # don't overpay
- fallback_strategy: PRICE_OPTIMIZED
- region_preference: [us-central1, us-east1]
```
Small comment: on GCP preemptible there is no 'max_price' but conceptually keep the multiplier in our allocator.

anya_ml: Also add per-model routing: latency-critical models route only to the capacity-optimized pool. Non-critical go to mixed/fallback. That avoids noisy degradation for chat endpoints.

ravi_oncall: I'm going to run a quick drill: increase scale_down_delay and bump min_nodes by 10 now. I'll post results in 5m.

sam_infra: If you can, also flip a canary: change one shard (shard-7) to the new policy and monitor eviction rate + Pod restarts. Keep the rest on old config.

ravi_oncall: canary started on shard-7 at 2180000300.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: shard-7 policy -> capacity-optimized primary, fallback price-optimized applied at 2180000320.

leo_sourcing: FYI we should watch inter-region bandwidth cost when failing over to us-east1 — cross-region cache misses could add $0.02/token on tail ops. Worth adding a quick cost estimate for 24h worst-case.

mark_prod: Also add a rollout abort condition: if end-to-end p50 latency > 2x baseline or error-rate increases > 0.5% for 10m, revert canary.

anya_ml: Agreed. I'll attach a small eval set to the canary to track quality regressions too (prompt->response diff).

ravi_oncall: Canary metrics after 10m: eviction rate down 47% on shard-7, p95 latency stable, cold-starts decreased. No regresses so far.

sam_infra: nice. Let's schedule a staged rollout across shards with 15m windows, and keep the warm buffer for at least 48h. I'll open a PR for terraform changes (tags: infra/spot-hedge).

leo_sourcing: One more operational note: add a periodic job to recompute region preference every 4h based on capacity signals so we don't get stuck on stale topology.

sam_infra: good idea. I'll add a small controller that sets allocation weights. Pseudocode: 
```
weights = score_regions(market_signal, historical_evictions, latency_slo)
apply_weights(serving-pool, weights)
```

mark_prod: thanks team. If canary stays healthy, proceed. Post-rollback playbook: revert allocations -> scale min_nodes back -> clear warm buffer after 48h.

ravi_oncall: rolling canary to next 3 shards now.

deploy-bot: rollout-progress: shard-8,9,10 -> policies applied at 2180000580, 2180000595, 2180000610.

sam_infra: closing loop: we'll monitor cost delta hourly. If we see >8% cost increase with <30% eviction reduction, we'll tune multiplier down. Thanks all :thumbsup:
